Teacher links

Each link opens in a new tab and pins that tool on the device it is opened on: the clue switches, unit list, Report and the Show button disappear, and the tool stays pinned (even from the start page) until it is unlocked below. Open the link on the child's device. This hides switches; it is not security — clearing the browser's site data removes it.

A pinned tool also asks for full screen on the first tap. If the child leaves full screen (Esc, F11 or another tab) the screen goes red until they go back, then shows a green tick for a moment. Each time they leave is counted in the report below.
